reviewer: Codex (AI-assisted source reading; not a human reviewer)
method: Read normalized source units and surrounding passages, compare each question and expected answer to actual text; separately run exact quote containment. Review completed before any retrieval experiment. No automatic hit scores used as labels.
initial_validation: First download check found 9 matching and 11 nonmatching draft quotes; additional answer/scope defects were found by reading source.
split_policy: Original IDs q01-q15 dev and q16-q20 test retained. Source corrections were made before the first dev/test experiment. All questions receive chapter context explicitly before retrieval. Dev includes IX and XI, so test is a question holdout, not a disjoint chapter holdout.
